blocks.content: Agent Observability can seed a set of sample conversations, agents, evaluation rules, a generation dependency graph, and workflow-step telemetry with one click, so you can read its views before an agent of your own sends anything. This guide seeds that data and confirms it arrived.
Open the Agent Observability landing page and seed the demo data.

Go to the Agent Observability landing page. On a stack with no data yet, **Observability** > **Agent** opens this page on its own; on a stack that already has data, it is **Learn more** in the sidebar.

blocks.reftarget: Or explore instantly with one-click demo data
blocks.content: Under **Start setup** and **Read the docs**, click **Or explore instantly with one-click demo data**. Agent Observability seeds the demo data.
blocks.hint: No demo button? The stack most likely has its demo data already. Skip this step and confirm the data in the next section.
blocks.authorNote: Open question 6 (outline): the docs' get-started page calls this button One-click demo on the onboarding screen; the product's button reads Or explore instantly with one-click demo data and sits on the landing page. Selector follows the product text. The button was absent on the author's stack at build time because the demo was already seeded, so the button step is unexercised; smoke-test it on a fresh stack and confirm it is a <button> element (the button action matches button text only). Observed on 2026-10-24: after seeding, the button was replaced by Demo data loaded · See conversations and later disappeared; the docs do not say this, so the step no longer states it (claim check 2026-10-27). introduction.md says Configuration holds demo data controls, which the author's stack did not show.

blocks.content: You seeded the demo data. Everything it created carries a **Demo** badge in the Agent Observability views.
Go to **Agent Observability** > **Conversations**. This link sets the time range to **Last 30 days**, which covers a demo seeded now or in the last month.
The list shows eight demo conversations, each with a **Demo** badge beside its title, such as **Q1 Revenue Analysis**. Their **Agents** column names agents that start with `sigil.demo.`.
You confirmed the demo data is on your stack. The same demo agents appear in **Agents**.

No demo rows in **Conversations**? Check these in order:

1. The time range covers the moment you seeded the demo. Widen it and click the refresh button.
2. The seeding finished. Go back to the landing page; if the demo button is still there, click it again.
3. Agent Observability is enabled on this stack. The **Connect an agent to Agent Observability** path enables it in its first milestone.

For what the demo contains, refer to [Try the demo](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/get-started/grafana-cloud/#try-the-demo).
